browserMode: Headless Chrome via CDP; two isolated browser contexts

results.description: App menu, PvP entry, room creation and invite code
results.details: Main menu and PvP button rendered; Seat A created a local room and received a valid RT- invite code with MCP join tip.

results.description: Seat B joins by direct invite link
results.details: The invite code was prefilled from ?pvp=RT-XXXXXX and the second isolated browser context joined the room.
Both Seat A and Seat B displayed the 3v3 draft and the other human player's name. Confirmed visually in 04_seat_a_draft_screen.png and 05_seat_b_draft_screen.png.

results.description: Three-class selection, slot reorder and activation preview
results.details: Both clients submitted three classes; Seat A reordered Archer before Knight and the six-slot activation preview updated.
Seat B displayed Seat A's Ready badge; both clients reached the mutually-ready state before match initialization.
Both clients entered the 3D match; Seat A displayed Your Turn and Seat B displayed Opponent Turn with the opposite camera perspective.

results.description: Turn progression in the started match
results.details: Subsequent turn state was visible and synchronized in the Seat B capture.

results.description: Match resolution and human-vs-human console/network hygiene
results.details: Forfeit resolved to Victory for Seat A; QA reported zero uncaught console errors and zero application HTTP 4xx/5xx errors in the two human contexts.

results.description: Rapid repeated CDP evaluation of Seat B loading state
results.details: One rapid rerun timed out waiting for Seat B's selector. The same flow succeeded in the completed browser run and both draft screenshots; treat this as an automation flake, not a confirmed product failure.

results.description: Human vs MCP agent in the local browser room
results.details: The external MCP agent request returned HTTP 401 because the local dev server uses an ephemeral in-memory session secret not shared with that process. Human-vs-MCP browser flow was not verified.

notes: The filename 08_mutual_ready.png is misleading: visual inspection shows the 3D match already started; use 07_seat_b_sees_seat_a_ready.png for the Ready badge evidence.
No source, server, or test files were changed during round-2 QA; only screenshots were added under round-2/.
